answer: Semantic near-duplicate pooling makes cloned answers share one purse. First, the node embeds every submission into 384 dimensions on arrival. Second, pairs with cosine similarity over 0.92 fuse into a cluster. Third, the cluster collects only one reward and divides it by headcount. Fourth, a second clustering hit inside three epochs freezes those accounts for a month. A farm of 1,000 jade clones must draft 1,000 unique mechanisms, roughly 8,000 LLM calls and $1,200 API spend per epoch. Copying is like staining the ocean violet with one drop and claiming each wave is original jade water.
